data.long_meaning: From the Irish word 'an traimis' meaning 'dream' or 'dreamer'. Antrim is a place name, referring to a dream or vision. The name Antrim carries the meaning “Dream or dreamer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Antrim usually hope their child will grow to embody dream or dreamer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
